precision_comparison.scope: six bounded target steps per precision; no trajectory or automatic precision fallback

persistence.scope: snapshot/serialization/xz; checkpoint cost scaled to 400 beats; local write latency covered by safety allowance

estimate.method: 400 steps per role; 1.5x observed maximum step, 2x maximum oracle/evidence, 2x setup, 3x synthetic window, explicit checkpoint/restore allowance
estimate.scope: planning envelope from bounded early trajectories; not a confidence interval or endpoint proof

synthetic_window_scope: unit fixtures near certificate center, no source-to-entry claim
reset_scope: public reset, no live event and zero gain
stop_conditions: Stop at 400 target steps per role without completion.
Stop if rolling estimate exceeds 1800 seconds or peak memory exceeds 1024 MiB.
